verdict.rationale: Kick documents its own MCP server. Its docs include an MCP quickstart, per-client connector guides for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and custom AI tools, an available-tools page, and the statement that it works with any MCP-compatible assistant. Through it, agents can query transactions, generate reports, create rules and make approved bookkeeping changes. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP endpoint works as documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
